annotation.title_clean: The Weaponization of Humanoid Robots from the Perspective of the Security Dilemma: Implications for Global Power and Governance
annotation.title_en: The Weaponization of Humanoid Robots from the Perspective of the Security Dilemma: Implications for Global Power and Governance
annotation.venue: Journal of International Economics and Global Governance (MOSP)
annotation.summary_en: Journal article applying security dilemma theory to the military weaponization of humanoid robots. It analyses technical traits, battlefield and ethical effects (accountability gaps) and interstate competition between China and the US, and calls for multilateral "good governance" with China promoting consensus and co-creating governance structures.
key_provisions_or_claims: Humanoid robots are expected to become core of future AI arsenals, replacing human combatants.
Weaponization intensifies security dilemma and arms race, mainly between China and the US.
Traditional accountability systems are ill-equipped for harm by autonomous humanoid weapons.
Calls for multilateral consensus and co-created global governance structures.
China should assume great-power responsibility to turn risks into strategic opportunities.
